title: Seacrest Bumblebee Cottage Panama City Beach, Florida 30A Vacay
description_expanded: OverviewRecenty Updated! Private Beach-5 Minute Walk - Lagoon Pool - `Bumblebee Cottage`The Space Bumblebee Cottage – Newly Remodeled Beach Retreat Near Lagoon Pool! QUICK HIGHLIGHTS: Quick Walk to 12,000 Sq. Ft. Lagoon Pool – One of the best pools on 30A! Newly Remodeled & Professionally Decorated – Stylish, modern coastal design Walking Distance to the Beach – Just a 5-minute stroll to the sugar-white sands 3 Beach Cruiser Bikes Included – Explore Seacrest Beach & nearby communities Spacious 3-Story Layout – 3 Bedrooms / 3.5 Bathrooms – Plenty of space for families Private 3rd-Floor Owner’s Retreat – King bedroom, sitting area, mini-fridge, & private balcony Open-Concept Living & Dining – New appliances, bar seating, & dining for 8 Multiple Covered Porches – Enjoy outdoor dining & palm-lined street views High-Speed Wi-Fi & Smart TVs – Includes digital cable with HBO at no extra cost Propane Grill on Balcony – Perfect for grilling fresh seafood or steaks Driveway Parking for 2 Vehicles – Hassle-free & convenient Professionally Managed – 24/7 guest support for a seamless vacation experienceWelcome to Bumblebee CottageBumblebee Cottage is a stunning, 3-bedroom, 3.5-bathroom, 3-story beach home that is sure to become your family’s next favorite home away from home! Located within the neighborhood of Seacrest Beach, a picturesque community of Florida Cottage style homes nestled along the north side of Scenic Highway 30A, this newly remodeled home has super-fast WiFi and is a block away from the 12,000 square foot pool. You're a brisk five minute walk to the sandy white shores of the Emerald Coast!As you walk through the front door of this luxurious, sunny residence you'll find two bedrooms on the terrace level. One is a twin over twin bunk room that is almost certain to be a hit with the kids! The other is a queen guest room which is the perfect place for older kids or Mom and Dad! Both bedrooms feature en suite bathrooms and flat panel televisions.Head on up to the second floor where you will find the primary living space. The well-appointed and newly remodeled kitchen features brand new appliances and has everything you need to prepare the perfect meal for your family. The center island features bar seating for four. The table in the dining area has seating for eight. The kitchen and dining area open up to the family room which is outfitted with a large, flat panel television, Sonos speaker, two plush sofas and an oversized chair. On the second floor near the kitchen is a conveniently located half bath.No matter where you are in this open concept living space, your family can regale each other with tales of adventure from your days spent either lounging at the beach, the spectacular lagoon pool, or taking in all the wonderful sights and sounds of Scenic Highway 30A! French doors flanking either side of the television take you onto second floor porch offering a beautiful view of the palm-tree lined streets of this Florida-cottage inspired community. Also on the second story porch is a propane barbecue perfect for grilling steak, seafood, chicken or vegetables to perfection.When you are done for the day and you are ready to recharge, you can make your way to the third floor — the entirety of which is the owners' retreat. The spacious master bedroom features a king bed and dresser storage for clothes. At the back of the third floor of the home is a sitting area outfitted with a comfortable sofa, mini-fridge, coffee maker and large flat-panel television. A doorway takes you out to the third-floor covered porch which is the perfect setting to enjoy a hot cup of coffee or tea first thing in the morning!Each bedroom features its own ensuite bathroom. All televisions feature digital cable connections with a wide variety of channels including HBO at no additional cost. The home includes complimentary WiFi service powered by gigabit Internet service from the local cable company.House Rules**No Pets!****No Smoking!****No Parties!****The primary renter must be at least 25 years old****No units will be rented to vacationing students or young adults under 25 unaccompanied by a responsible parent or guardian at a ratio of three (3) children/young adults to one (1) adult over the age of 25****30A Vacay rental agreement is required to be signed prior to arrival*** 3 Adult Bikes are included** As of January 1, 2022, Golf Carts are prohibited in Seacrest Beach. Violators will be fined by the HOA.** Ongoing construction nearby*SLEEPING ARRANGEMENTS (6):1st Floor Bedroom - King1st Floor Bedroom - Bunk bed (twin over full)3rd Floor Bedroom - QueenAREA ATTRACTIONS:Seacrest Beach is a tranquil coastal community nestled along Florida’s Scenic Highway 30A, situated between Alys Beach and Rosemary Beach. Known for its colorful Florida cottage-style homes, the neighborhood offers a relaxed, bike-friendly atmosphere with streets named like Flip Flop Lane and Beach Bike Way. The centerpiece is the expansive 12,000-square-foot Seacrest Lagoon Pool, one of the largest private pools in Florida, surrounded by lush landscaping and an amphitheater for community events. Residents and guests enjoy deeded beach access via a boardwalk or seasonal tram service, making it easy to reach the sugar-white sands and turquoise waters. The Village of South Walton serves as the town center, featuring Peddler’s Pavilion—a hub for bike rentals, casual dining, and boutique shopping. The community also boasts shaded walking trails, a farmers' market, and a relaxed pace that appeals to families and vacationers seeking both serenity and convenience.​** As of January 1, 2022, Golf Carts are prohibited in Seacrest Beach. Violators will be fined by the HOA.**Show less
